about.hero-text-1: My fascination with technology began at the age of 13. I grew up immersed in books by the industry's greatest innovators. Among them, Steve Jobs' vision and story became my greatest inspiration, fundamentally shaping my way of thinking.
about.hero-text-2: That impact was so strong that it pushed me out of my comfort zone to study abroad for a year, far from home. That adventure turned into one of the best experiences of my life, forging the engineering and design mindset I bring to every project today.

projects.description: A selection of my most recent projects
projects.title: Projects

getsoft.title: GETSOFT 2.0 - Indie Software & Game Dev Marketplace
getsoft.description: Next-generation editorial and technical marketplace engineered for indie game studios and developers. Built with a Python FastAPI async backend, portable SQLite with JSON arrays, Bcrypt authentication, React Vite UI, Hallmark Anti-AI-Slop industrial aesthetics, and hybrid Bash server orchestration.

restaurant-system.title: Expense Management System
restaurant-system.description: System designed for expense tracking, managing purchased inventory, generating detailed financial reports, and optimizing the business profitability in real time.

hotel-system.title: Safari's Hotel - Enterprise Resort System
hotel-system.description: Enterprise-grade resort management and operations platform featuring Dual Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for executives and staff. Architected with hardened PHP 8 / PDO MySQL security, Bcrypt auth, async AJAX operations, universal DB connector, and an Obsidian Hallmark UI.

grinch-animation.title: Interactive Grinch Christmas Animation
grinch-animation.description: Interactive Christmas character experience built from scratch using pure HTML5 and advanced CSS3 Keyframe animations. Features an interactive 3-size glowing heart with telemetry aura, pop-in speech bubble movie quotes, a winter snowfall engine, and a Hallmark editorial frame.

freelancer-portfolio.title: Freelancer Portfolio
freelancer-portfolio.description: A professional portfolio website layout featuring a modern architecture, fully responsive design, and SEO optimization.

responsive-landing.title: Responsive Online Store
responsive-landing.description: Mockup of an e-commerce storefront with a Mobile-First layout, clean formatting, and semantic HTML structure.

vaccination-page.title: Vaccination Info Page
vaccination-page.description: An interactive website displaying information regarding vaccination processes, guidelines, and booking schedules.

pokedex.title: Interactive Pokédex
pokedex.description: A web application consuming the PokeApi in real time to search, list, and detail the status of various Pokémon.

notary-system.title: CRM/ERP Notary Public No. 73
notary-system.description: Comprehensive platform to digitize, automate and control notary workflows. Includes mathematical engine for fees, automated Word deed generation, and Aspel SAE integration.

worldcup-app.title: World Cup 2026 Predictions
worldcup-app.description: Interactive web app for World Cup match predictions. Features real-time scoring, interactive knockout brackets, global leaderboards, admin panel, and anti-copy rules.
